final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID AS pid, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), p AS (SELECT g.pid, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total AS share FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM p), r AS (SELECT p.pid, p.cnt, p.share, p.share - a.avg_share AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE p.share > a.avg_share) SELECT pid, cnt, share, diff FROM r ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
